messages:
mai: who's actually awake for PSG vs Bayern? 3:00am kickoff. thinking of a tiny office watch — projector in the mezz? :soccer_ball:

jordan: I am if there's pizza. count me in for a 3am slice. :raised_hands:

sasha: projector + pizza = my kind of overtime. can someone grab a power strip?

eli: also willing to take bets. $5 on penalty shootout winner? winner buys next round of coffee. :money_with_wings:

riley: i'm in for $5. betting on the underdog to sneak one in extra time.

mai: love that. eli do you want Venmo or cash? I can collect at 2:45.

eli: Venmo works. tag me like @eli and i'll send request.

stream-bot: live stream link posted: https://stream.example/psg-vs-bayern (projector setup guide: `hdmi -> thunderbolt adaptor` if needed)

jordan: btw quick poll — pizza toppings? pick one
```
1) Margherita
2) Pepperoni
3) Veggie deluxe
4) Hot honey and ricotta (riley special)
```

sasha: 4 is cursed but also iconic. i vote 2 and 3 split.

riley: hot honey gang here. don't @ me.

mai: ok pizza order = 2 x pepperoni, 1 x veggie, 1 x hot honey. anyone allergic to gluten?

eli: none here. also FYI — reminder the office fantasy footy transfer window closes 2pm. I'm making a last-second swap for Mbappé.

jordan: that's illegal in my heart but valid in the rules.

mai: last logistical note — mezz projector is booked at 2:50 by @ops, but they said we can use if we finish early. bring a blanket if you're napping before kickoff.

riley: sleeping on keyboard is a real risk. i'll bring earplugs but also full vuvuzela energy.

mai: raffle: whoever predicts final scorer and minute wins a mystery candy bar. eli, riley, jordan, sasha — put your guesses in thread. single choice only.

eli: Mbappé, 72'

riley: Lewandowski, 88'

jordan: Kimmich, 54'

sasha: Neymar, 102' (extra time)

mai: solid picks. see you all at 2:45am (meet at mezz). will post confirmation if projector backup needed. :thumbsup: 

stream-bot: reminder set for 2:40am — projector check and pizza pickup.

jordan: also, if the game goes to penalties we should create a tiny spreadsheet to track winners. i'll DM a link.

mai: perfect. this is the weirdest cross between a tailgate and a sleepover. love it. :grinning:
